As a result, all of us lost one full day’s salary, which was a direct financial loss caused by the agency’s negligence and lack of support.

Another serious concern is that for self-drive rental services, vehicles are expected to be registered as commercial vehicles. However, this agency is using private vehicles for commercial rental purposes, which raises legal, insurance, and safety issues for customers. The security deposit refund process was also highly unprofessional. Even after repeated follow-up calls, the full deposit amount was not returned on time. Although we were told the refund would be processed within two days, it actually took 9 days to receive the complete amount.

Overall, I strongly do not recommend Alpha Self Drive Cars. Poor vehicle condition, use of private vehicles for commercial service, irresponsible agent behavior, lack of customer support, delayed refunds, and no accountability clearly show unprofessional service. Serious improvement is required in vehicle maintenance, legal compliance, communication, and customer handling.
